source.title: CFD model of refuelling through the entire equipment of a hydrogen refuelling station

reported_experiment.facility: NREL Hydrogen Infrastructure Testing and Research Facility (HITRF)

access_observation.paper_experiment_data_representation: The authors state that the experimental data for Test No.1 were digitized from graphs in the earlier NREL study.

classification.claim_role: published real-station face-validity and acquisition lead

claim_boundary: The open IJHE paper is strong evidence that a complete HRS-to-three-tank experiment exists and reports the relevant channels, but its comparison uses digitized curves and does not release the synchronized NREL logger rows. It may support protocol and operating-range context and a data request; it cannot close the untouched full-loop external-validation gate or the validated-digital-twin completion rule.
minimum_requested_package: de-identified synchronized NREL Test No.1 logger rows
initial conditions, tank capacity and protocol metadata
written reuse terms for derived metrics, open deposition and IJHE publication
